sql: WITH h AS (SELECT s.prod_id,t.calendar_year y,t.calendar_month_number m,SUM(amount_sold) a FROM sales s JOIN customers c USING(cust_id) JOIN countries co USING(country_id) JOIN times t USING(time_id) JOIN promotions p USING(promo_id) JOIN channels ch USING(channel_id) WHERE co.country_name='France' AND p.promo_total_id=1 AND ch.channel_total_id=1 AND t.calendar_year IN(2019,2020,2021) GROUP BY 1,2,3),p AS (SELECT prod_id,m,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2019 THEN a END) a19,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2020 THEN a END) a20,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2021 THEN a END) a21 FROM h GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT m,SUM(a19>0 AND a20 IS NOT NULL) pairs,SUM(a19>0 AND a20 IS NOT NULL AND a21 IS NOT NULL) pairs_with_2021,AVG(CASE WHEN a19>0 AND a20 IS NOT NULL AND a21 IS NOT NULL THEN a20*a20/a19 END) restricted_mean FROM p GROUP BY m ORDER BY m
